li.label: the cat let me go
li.description: A cat stayed by me the whole time I was at my worst. When I came through it got up, stretched and walked off, as if it had been waiting to see which way I'd go.

plain.li: [threshold] The cat has come to lie by {OTHER}, and that's never a good sign.
[threshold] Leave the cat be, it's sitting the watch with {OTHER}.
[threshold] It won't leave {OTHER}, like it's waiting for someone to come for them.
[threshold,named] {GOD}'s cat is at the door for {OTHER}, so keep them here.
[threshold,scoffer] Cats like warm beds, that's all it is.
[died] The cat stayed with {OTHER} to the very end.
[died] It's still lying by {OTHER}, it won't leave them.
[died,named] {GOD} took {OTHER} across, and the cat saw them over.
[lost] It's {DEAD}, the cat found {DEAD} out here.
[lost] That cat was crying for {DEAD} all morning, and now I know why.
[lost,named] {GOD} sent the cat to bring {DEAD} home.
[lost,scoffer] A cat smelled a body, there's nothing holy in that.
